scope: Offline statistical research only; no broker/provider activation
label: gross future close / next full 15m bar open - 1; enter15m after closed-feature decision, exit4h after entry

folds.purge: label end strictly before next phase start; all pairs share UTC boundaries

validationChoice: lowest MAE across identical validation rows, abstentions scored as zero; ridge ineligible if coverage below95percent; ties favor zero then mean then ridge
tradeDiagnostic: fixed horizon only, not actual broker/mock strategy. Forecast must exceed compounded round-trip fee/spread/slippage cost plus0.5percent; top3positive candidates per6h group,10percent capital each, rest cash, simultaneous markets correlated. No leverage/stops; gaps/execution reality unknown.
baselineComparisons: zero/mean/ridge and selected use identical fixed-horizon capital/cost assumptions. Existing frozen RuleBasedProvider full-period baseline remains separately preserved, not falsely claimed as same strategy.
metrics: sample/unique UTC time/pair counts, independence unknown
success: Do not enable any model or claim profit. Report results including failures; compare more regimes/cost stress/prospective evidence before proposing deployment.
change: Broader shared archive window and predeclared2x cost sensitivity only; identical models/features/lambda/selection/capital rules. Not hyperparameter tuning.
window: from ceil6h(max(first bar open across markets)+3UTCdays), to min(last bar close across markets); no dataset or default-pointer replacement
stressViews: adaptive: same forecasts and0.5percent margin,2x costs and recomputed eligibility
paired: original base-cost selected positions repriced at2x costs with unchanged identities/times; endpoint net return must not improve
coverageMetrics: All test rows, same zero imputation for abstentions; pooled simultaneous pairs/adjacent folds dependent; independent sample count unknown
aggregation: Only non-overlapping chronological test windows; compound same diagnostic capital rules, weighted test forecast errors. Not actual broker performance or prospective evidence.
